items.name: DSF Hospital Suite
items.description: DSF Software's healthcare and enterprise suite for spa and clinic chains: booking and bed scheduling, Customer 360, Employee 360 and MISA AMIS accounting sync, run as multi-tenant SaaS.
items.problem: Multi-branch spas and clinics need one platform for booking, bed scheduling and customer care.
items.myRole: Technical Lead · Full-stack: own the Spa domain end to end, built the technical foundation, review developers' pull requests against project standards, facilitate Sprint Reviews and sign off on quality.
tasks: Built the foundation in the first month: RBAC, account lockout that ends active sessions immediately, a service-layer architecture, a Design System with a shared data table, vi/en localization, and automated testing with xUnit and Playwright E2E.
Designed a multi-tenant MISA AMIS sync: a fault-tolerant queue with a monitoring screen, ledger mapping, inventory vouchers with unit-of-measure conversion, OAuth and webhooks.
Built the Spa modules: technician shifts synced with HRM and payroll, a 4-state bed map, consumables tracking (BOM), and treatment packages with before/after photos.
Customer 360 (18 REST endpoints, interaction timeline, VIP tiers, Zalo OA/ZNS reminders) and Employee 360 (title history, skills matrix, append-only commission ledger).
Booking system: a state-machine appointment lifecycle, staff and room calendars, a lobby queue and an online booking portal.
Review developers' pull requests for architecture, structure and project standards, resolving security issues weekly; stabilized multi-tenant migrations and the Docker/Linux CI pipeline.
Apply AI to streamline and automate workflows, raising product quality.
items.impact: A real-time Front Desk Dashboard (appointments, waiting guests, free beds) and a CRM reporting lead sources, return rate and staff performance.

items.name: Vibe Cafe Order
items.description: QR ordering for take-away coffee shops: customers scan, pick drinks, sizes and toppings and track their order in real time; the owner gets orders with a sound alert on a 3-column dashboard and toggles menu items from a phone.
items.problem: At rush hour a take-away shop brews and takes verbal orders at once, so drinks get mixed up, orders get missed and customers leave.
items.myRole: Designed and built everything: the customer app, the owner dashboard, the database and real-time sync.
tasks: QR menu: customers pick drinks, size, toppings and notes and order without installing an app.
Real-time dashboard with a sound alert for new orders and Waiting → Brewing → Done columns.
Customers track their order live and can cancel while it is still waiting.
The owner toggles items, changes prices and uploads photos from a phone.
items.impact: Customers order quickly from their phone with no app to install; the owner gets complete orders without leaving the espresso machine.
